literal_meaning: কারণ (reason) + সুধা (nectar); word-by-word: nectar of reason
figurative_meaning_en: sarcastic term for alcohol or liquor
example_sentences_in_bangla: পার্টিতে সবাই কারণ সুধা খেয়ে উচ্ছ্বসিত হয়ে উঠল।
তার কারণ সুধার প্রতি আসক্তি তার জীবন নষ্ট করে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone got excited after drinking the nectar of reason at the party.
His addiction to that sarcastic nectar has ruined his life.
history: Popularized in Bengali film songs, such as the line from a classic song referencing 'কারণসুধা' as a veiled term for alcohol to evade censorship or social taboos.
note: This idiom uses indirect language to refer to alcohol, reflecting Bengali cultural sensitivities around discussing intoxicants openly.
